svg.title: PostgreSQL: slots and WAL
svg.desc: Illustrative Friday-to-Sunday interruption. A red bookmark marks the saved capture position. Solid dark blocks show retained history; hatched blocks show removed history. The first timeline can resume. The second cannot resume because required history is missing. PostgreSQL also shows growing WAL storage and a third timeline where an enabled idle timeout invalidates the slot even if WAL remains.

g.text: The slot keeps the required WAL.
Disk usage grows while RDI is stopped.
A slot limit allows WAL removal.
invalidates the slot at a checkpoint.
WAL availability alone is not enough.
